preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is an integer between 1 and 10,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(N, int) and 2 <= N <= 200000 for N in [int(lines[i]) for i in range(1, len(lines)) if i % (N + 1) == 1])
preconditions.description: For each test case, N is an integer between 2 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= N and 1 <= v <= N for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: For each edge (u, v) in a test case with N vertices, both u and v are integers between 1 and N inclusive.
Each test case contains exactly N-1 edges.
The sum of N over all test cases does not exceed 200,000.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(int(line), int) and int(line) >= 0 for line in stdout_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line is a non-negative integer representing the minimum number of edges to add.

postconditions.expression: all(output_value == max(0, leaf_count - 2) for output_value, leaf_count in zip([int(line) for line in stdout_lines], [count_leaves(tree) for tree in trees]))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output equals the maximum of 0 and (number of leaves in the tree minus 2), which is the minimum edges needed to form a Hamiltonian path.
